# 形式
# 機械語[スペース]マイクロコード[スペース]Instruciton Class Number[スペース]#コメント
# 同じ機械語に対応するマイクロコードは、連続した行に書く。飛び飛びに書いてはならない。
# マイクロコードと#の間のスペースは必ず開けること。

# 注意：aaaa,bbbを用いたレジスタの展開記法が使えるのは、一つの機械語につき一つのマイクロコードが対応している場合のみである。
# それ以外の場合でレジスタの展開記法を用いると、aaaa,bbbの行で名前を展開してしまうため、意図通りの展開にならない。

0xxx0xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 000000000000000001111000 1 # IE=0 (during fetch)
00xx10000101111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jnc opd (Taken)
01xx10000101111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnc opd (Skip)
01xx10000110011111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jc opd (Taken)
00xx10000110011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jc opd (Skip)
0x0x10000110111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jnz opd (Taken)
0x1x10000110111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnz opd (Skip)
0x1x10000111011111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jz opd (Taken)
0x0x10000111011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jz opd (Skip)
0xx010000111111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jns opd (Taken)
0xx110000111111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jns opd (Skip)
0xx110001000011111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # js opd (Taken)
0xx010001000011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # js opd (Skip)

0xxx10001000111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jmp opd
0x1x10001011011111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # je opd (Taken)
0x0x10001011011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # je opd (Skip)
0x0x10001011111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jne opd(Taken)
0x1x10001011111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jne opd(Skip)
0x0010001100011111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # ja opd (Taken)
0xxx10001100011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # ja opd (Skip)
0x0010001100111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jae opd (Taken)
0x1010001100111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jae opd (Taken)
0xxx10001100111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jae opd (Skip)
0x0110001101011111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jl opd (Taken)
0xxx10001101011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jl opd (Skip)
0x0110001101111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jle opd (Taken)
0x1010001101111111111 000000111000000000111000 1 # jle opd (Taken)
0xxx10001101111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jle opd (Skip)
0xxx10001001111111111 000100000000000001111000 1 # hlt
0xxx10001010011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # nop
0xxxx1111111111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # invaild
0xxx10001010111111111 000001010000000001010000 1 # lpc

# --- 算術・論理演算 (add, sub, mul, and, or, xor, div) ---
# reg-reg
0xxx100000000aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb000aaaaa000 1 # add r1, r2
0xxx100000001aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb001aaaaa000 1 # sub r1, r2
0xxx100000010aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb010aaaaa000 1 # mul r1, r2
0xxx100000011aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb011aaaaa000 1 # and r1, r2
0xxx100000100aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb100aaaaa000 1 # or r1, r2
0xxx100000110aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb110aaaaa000 1 # xor r1, r2
0xxx100000111aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb111aaaaa000 1 # shr r1, r2

# reg-opd
0xxx100000000aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111000aaaaa000 1 # add r1, opd
0xxx100000001aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111001aaaaa000 1 # sub r1, opd
0xxx100000010aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111010aaaaa000 1 # mul r1, opd
0xxx100000011aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111011aaaaa000 1 # and r1, opd
0xxx100000100aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111100aaaaa000 1 # or r1, opd
0xxx100000110aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111110aaaaa000 1 # xor r1, opd
0xxx100000111aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1111111aaaaa000 1 # shr r1, opd

# reg-[memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000000aaaa1001 0010010011aaa000aaaaa010 1 # add r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000001aaaa1001 0010010011aaa001aaaaa010 1 # sub r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000010aaaa1001 0010010011aaa010aaaaa010 1 # mul r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000011aaaa1001 0010010011aaa011aaaaa010 1 # and r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000100aaaa1001 0010010011aaa100aaaaa010 1 # or r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000110aaaa1001 0010010011aaa110aaaaa010 1 # xor r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx100000111aaaa1001 0010010011aaa111aaaaa010 1 # shr r1, [memaddr+opd]


0xxx10000000010111111 001001011111100001010000 1 # add memval,opd

# not
0xxx100000101aaaa1111 0010aaaaa1000101aaaaa000 1 # not r1

# --- データ転送 (mov, in, out) ---
0xxx100001000aaaabbbb 0000bbbbb0000000aaaaa000 1 # mov r1, r2
0xxx100001000aaaa1001 0000010010000000aaaaa010 1 # mov r1, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx10000100010111001 000001001000000001010010 1 # mov memval, [memaddr+opd]
0xxx1000010001010aaaa 0000aaaaa000000001001000 1 # mov memaddr,r1
0xxx1000010001011aaaa 0000aaaaa000000001010000 1 # mov memval,r1
0xxx10000100010101010 000000000000000001111011 1 # mov [memaddr+opd],memval
0xxx10000100010101111 000000111000000001001000 1 # mov memaddr, opd
0xxx10000100010111111 000000111000000001010000 1 # mov memval, opd
0xxx100001000aaaa1111 00000011100000000aaaa000 1 # mov r1, opd
0xxx100001001aaaa1111 00000100000000000aaaa000 1 # in r1
0xxx100001010aaaa1111 00000aaaa000000001000000 1 # out r1
0xxx10000101011111111 000000111000000001000000 1 # out opd


# --- 比較 ---
0xxx100010010aaaabbbb 0010aaaaa1bbb00101111000 1 # cmp r1, r2
0xxx100010010aaaa1111 0010aaaaa111100101111000 1 # cmp r1, opd


# jmp,jcc命令
0xxx10001000110111111 000001011000000000111000 1 # jmp memval

00xx100001011aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jnc r1 (Taken)
01xx100001011aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnc r1 (Skip)
01xx100001100aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jc r1 (Taken)
00xx100001100aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jc r1 (Skip)
0x0x100001101aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jnz r1 (Taken)
0x1x100001101aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnz r1 (Skip)
0x1x100001110aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jz r1 (Taken)
0x0x100001110aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jz r1 (Skip)
0xx0100001111aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jns r1 (Taken)
0xx1100001111aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jns r1 (Skip)
0xx1100010000aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # js r1 (Taken)
0xx0100010000aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # js r1 (Skip)
0xxx100010001aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jmp r1
0x1x100010110aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # je r1 (Taken)
0x0x100010110aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # je r1 (Skip)
0x0x100010111aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jne r1(Taken)
0x1x100010111aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jne r1(Skip)
0x00100011000aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # ja r1 (Taken)
0xxx100011000aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # ja r1 (Skip)
0x00100011001aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jae r1 (Taken)
0x10100011001aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jae r1 (Taken)
0xxx100011001aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jae r1 (Skip)
0x01100011010aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jl r1 (Taken)
0xxx100011010aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jl r1 (Skip)
0x01100011011aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jle r1 (Taken)
0x10100011011aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000000111000 1 # jle r1 (Taken) 
0xxx100011011aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jle r1 (Skip)
0xxx10001110111111111 000000111000000001101000 1 # setinaddr opd
0xxx100011101aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000001101000 1 # setinaddr r1
0xxx10001111011111111 000000111000000001110000 1 # setoutaddr opd
0xxx100011110aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000001110000 1 # setoutaddr r1


#setreadburstmode
0xxx10001111111111111 100000000000000000100000 2 # MOR <- 0x0020(Next or FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10001111111111111 010001100111110001011000 2 # setreadburstmode

#clearreadburstmode
0xxx10010000011111111 100000001111111111011111 2 # MOR <- 0xff9f(Next and FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10010000011111111 010001100111101101011000 2 # clearreadburstmode 

# setzerobufferpointer
0xxx10010000111111111 100000000000000000000000 2 # MOR <- 0x0000(Next mov buffer_pointer,MOR)
0xxx10010000111111111 010000111000000010001000 2 # setzerobufferpointer

# incbufferpointer
0xxx10010001011111111 100000000000000000000001 2 # MOR <- 0x0001(Next add buffer_pointer,1)
0xxx10010001011111111 010010001111100010001000 2 # incbufferpointer

0xxx10010001111111111 000000111000000010010000 1 # setbuffersize opd
0xxx100100011aaaa1111 0000aaaaa000000010010000 1 # setbuffersize r1

0xxx10010010011111111 000010000000000001010000 1 # buffertomemval

#setintdisableflag
0xxx10010010111111111 100000000000000000010000 2 # MOR <- 0x0010(Next or FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10010010111111111 010001100111110001011000 2 # setintdisableflag

#clearintdisableflag
0xxx10010011011111111 100000001111111111101111 2 # MOR <- 0xffef(Next and FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10010011011111111 010001100111101101011000 2 # clearintdisableflag 

# intret
0xxx10001110011111111 000000110000000001001000 7 # mov memaddr,sp
0xxx10001110011111111 100000000000000000000000 7 # MOR <- 0x0000
0xxx10001110011111111 010001001000000000111010 7 # mov pc,[memaddr+0]
0xxx10001110011111111 100000000000000000000001 7 # MOR <- 0x0001
0xxx10001110011111111 010000110111100000110000 7 # add sp,1
0xxx10001110011111111 100000001111111111001111 7 # MOR <- 0xFF9F(Next and FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10001110011111111 010001100111101101011000 7 # intret

#syscall
0xxx10010011111111111 100000001111111110111111 6 # MOR <- 0xffbf
0xxx10010011111111111 010001100111101101011000 6 # and FLAGS,MOR switch kernel_mode
0xxx10010011111111111 100000000000000111111111 6 # MOR <- 0x01ff
0xxx10010011111111111 010000111000000001100000 6 # mov INTNUM,MOR
0xxx10010011111111111 100000000000000000001000 6 # MOR <- 0x0008(Next or FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10010011111111111 010001100111110001011000 6 # syscall

#usercall
0xxx10010100011111111 100000000000000001000000 10 # MOR <- 0x0040
0xxx10010100011111111 010001100111110001011000 10 # or FLAGS,MOR
0xxx10010100011111111 000001010000000001010000 10 # mov memval,pc
0xxx10010100011111111 100000000000000000000000 10 # MOR <- 0x0000
0xxx10010100011111111 010001011111100001010000 10 # add memval,MOR
0xxx10010100011111111 100000000101000100100000 10 # MOR <- 0x5120
0xxx10010100011111111 010000111000000001001000 10 # mov memaddr,MOR
0xxx10010100011111111 100000000000000000000000 10 # MOR <- 0x0000
0xxx10010100011111111 010001011000000001111011 10 # mov [memaddr+opd],memval(next jmp opd)
0xxx10010100011111111 000000111000000000111000 10 # usercall


#userretload
0xxx10010100111111111 100000001111111110111111 6 # MOR <- 0xffbf
0xxx10010100111111111 010001100111101101011000 6 # and FLAGS,MOR switch kernel_mode
0xxx10010100111111111 100000000101000100100000 6 # MOR <- 0x5120
0xxx10010100111111111 010000111000000001001000 6 # mov memaddr,MOR
0xxx10010100111111111 100000000000000000000000 6 # MOR <- 0x0000(next mov pc,[memaddr+0])
0xxx10010100111111111 010001001000000000111010 6 # userret

#switchusermode
0xxx10010101011111111 100000000000000001000000 2 # MOR <- 0x0040(next or FLAGS,MOR)
0xxx10010101011111111 010001100111110001011000 2 # switchusermode

# Interrupt
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 100000000101000000000000 0 # MOR <- 0x5000
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 010001101111100001100000 0 # add INTNUM,MOR
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 000001010000000001010000 0 # mov memval,pc
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 100000000000000000000001 0 # MOR <- 0x0001
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 010000110111100100110000 0 # sub sp,1
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 000000110000000001001000 0 # mov memaddr,sp
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 100000000000000000000000 0 # MOR <- 0x0000
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 010000000000000001111011 0 # mov [memaddr+opd],memval
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 000001101000000001001000 0 # mov memaddr,INTNUM
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 010001001000000001010010 0 # mov memval,[memaddr+0]
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 000001011000000000111000 0 # jmp memval
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 100000001111111111110111 0 # MOR <- 0xFFF7(Next and FLAGS,MOR)
1xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 010001100111101101011000 0 # Interrupt
